fonts.display: 'TWKLausanne-250', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'TWKLausanne-200', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Cosmic Violet
palette.role: Primary brand ink — outlined button borders, heading text on light surfaces, the only chromatic voice in the UI

palette.name: Twilight Indigo
palette.role: Deeper violet for secondary borders and gradient origins — bridges Cosmic Violet into the atmospheric range

palette.name: Aurora Teal
palette.role: Atmospheric teal pulled from the hero photography — background washes and the emotional color of the brand

palette.name: Polar White
palette.role: Primary text on the dark hero, light section surfaces, card backgrounds, button text on violet

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Text on light surfaces and deepest contrast points

palette.name: Silver Slate
palette.role: Near-gray stroke color for subtle decorative lines and secondary UI elements

palette.name: Cerulean Mist
palette.role: Decorative SVG stroke for iconography and illustration accents

palette.name: Storm Shadow
palette.role: Muted blue used for link focus-ring shadows and hover glows
